# International phone validation

Pinned `libphonenumber-js` 1.12.29, max metadata bundle, from the official npm distribution at https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/libphonenumber-js@1.12.29/bundle/libphonenumber-max.js. MIT license is included in `LICENSE`. The bundle provides country calling prefixes and national number validation without an external lookup. English country labels use the browser's `Intl.DisplayNames`.

This data does not verify ownership, residence or account identity. It does not send phone numbers anywhere. Trailing whitespace was normalized without changing code or license wording; `SHA256SUMS` records the distributed bytes. Existing Trip Check libraries and authentication remain separate.
